name: DockBay
summary: Grid of dock-bay cards. Each bay shows: bay number (mono), state (open / occupied / reserved / out-of-service), optional carrier + ETA. Color-coded by state via PILL tokens. Click to drill into bay detail.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER mix occupied + open + reserved without distinct colors.
NEVER fake an ETA (omit if unknown — don't show 'TBD' as a number).
